checks.integrity: Dock rendering/full-height fader geometry, native musical contact mapping, R34/R35/R37 analysis and preparation, editor identity, R41 launch paths and R42 browser layouts match build 94.
checks.review: Self-review under the project rule against parallel agents.

causes: Quiet grips removed the visible action-tray entry without a replacement.
FX/EQ first opening used the 200-point usable minimum as its preferred size.
A compacted deck could retain insufficient vertical space after opening FX/EQ.
An open section editor could obscure newly selected performance controls.
behaviour: Loaded decks have a labelled Controls button in the full header and a 44-point button beside the overview in compact strips.
Untouched FX/EQ defaults use half the available panel budget. At 1004-point deck width with quiet grips, each opens at 428 points. Explicit resize choices remain remembered.
Controls can open while FX/EQ occupy the panel budget. Held performance input gates remain enabled during redistribution.
Constrained panel drags start at their visible width, avoiding a dead zone. Cancelling restores the preceding intent.
Opening a pane makes enough vertical room for that deck where possible. The dock and fader stay fixed.
Switching performance panels hides the section editor while retaining its draft.
Large panel handles is also visible in the main Settings Features page, through the existing extras-only settings view.
limits: Erik still checks button access, pad size, FX selection, held gestures, editor return and clean audio.
Narrow layouts cannot show every optional pane at its full preferred size.
Memory lasts for the session. This is a regression test release, not TDJ1 or gig acceptance.
